newsitem.title: UK: Cortecs extends ulcer kit deal with Astra.
newsitem.headline: Cortecs extends ulcer kit deal with Astra.

text.p: Anglo-Australian drugs company Cortecs International Ltd said on Monday it had extended its agreement with Swedish firm Astra AB on its Helisal 'One Step' diagnostic kit for detecting ulcers.
The new agreement runs through to the end of 1999, and will be automatically renewed each year after that unless terminated by either party.

Cortecs Helisal 'One Step' is a small and completely self-contained test for detecting bacterium helicobacter pylori -- the main cause of peptic ulcers and gastritis -- the results for which are displayed within minutes.
Astra will create visibility for the Cortecs product in 33 countries, using it at gastro-intestinal meetings and including information about it in its medical education programmes.
